instruction: TOML 1.1 adds the \xHH escape to basic strings: a backslash, an x and exactly two hexadecimal digits (either case) giving a Unicode code point, so "\x4a" and "\x4A" both decode to "J" and "\x09" to a tab. Add support for it in basic strings, including multi-line basic strings. Literal strings are unaffected. The TOML-test suite case for this escape is currently skipped; enable it and add test data.
